title: Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation of New Urushiol Derivatives as Potent Class I Histone Deacetylase Inhibitors.
authors: Zhou, Hao; Qi, Zhiwen; Liu, Danyang; Xue, Xingyin; Wang, Chengzhang
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究漆酚衍生物作为组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂的设计合成与抗肿瘤活性，属于小分子-酶互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: In the present study, a novel series of 11 urushiol-based hydroxamic acid histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitors was designed, synthesized, and biologically evaluated. Compounds 1-11 exhibited good to excellent inhibitory activities against HDAC1/2/3 (IC(50) : 42.09-240.17 nM) and HDAC8 (IC(50) : 16.11-41.15 nM) in vitro, with negligible activity against HDAC6 (>1409.59 nM). Considering HDAC8, docking experiments revealed some important features contributing to inhibitory activity. According to Western blot analysis, select compounds could notably enhance the acetylation of histone H3 and SMC3 but not-tubulin, indicating their privileged structure is appropriate for targeting class I HDACs. Furthermore, antiproliferation assays revealed that six compounds exerted greater in vitro antiproliferative activity against four human cancer cell lines (A2780, HT-29, MDA-MB-231, and HepG2, with IC(50) values ranging from 2.31-5.13 muM) than suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid; administration of these compounds induced marked apoptosis in MDA-MB-231 cells, with cell cycle arrest in the G2/M phase. Collectively, specific synthesized compounds could be further optimized and biologically explored as antitumor agents.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，设计、合成并生物评价了一系列新型的11种基于漆酚的异羟肟酸组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂。化合物1-11在体外对HDAC1/2/3表现出良好至优异的抑制活性（IC(50)：42.09-240.17 nM），对HDAC8的抑制活性为IC(50)：16.11-41.15 nM，而对HDAC6的活性可忽略不计（>1409.59 nM）。针对HDAC8，对接实验揭示了若干有助于抑制活性的重要特征。根据Western blot分析，部分化合物能显著增强组蛋白H3和SMC3的乙酰化水平，但不影响微管蛋白，表明其优势结构适合靶向I类HDAC。此外，抗增殖实验显示，六种化合物对四种人癌细胞系（A2780、HT-29、MDA-MB-231和HepG2，IC(50)值范围为2.31-5.13 μM）的体外抗增殖活性优于辛二酰苯胺异羟肟酸；这些化合物的给药在MDA-MB-231细胞中诱导了显著的凋亡，并导致细胞周期阻滞于G2/M期。总体而言，特定合成的化合物可进一步优化并进行生物学探索，作为抗肿瘤药物。
